scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns equal-facet-area preservation for the three-dimensional Minkowski polytope associated with a spherical design. It does not claim that the transformed normals retain the same design strength and gives no quantitative near-rigidity estimate. The proof uses the primary source's exact facet-area transformation law and degree-four design exactness; the sharpness construction is checked symbolically but also proved analytically.
title: Fourth-order design strength is the sharp affine equal-area rigidity threshold
